theorem: On K>0, the Step45 z'-dependent boundary sector alpha=P dZ, P=pLg*(N+M*Lg/Lf), Z=D/sqrt(D^2+K^2), satisfies d alpha=dP wedge dZ. Its pullback is closed iff rank d(P,Z)<=1 on the chosen smooth boundary-data submanifold.
graph_example: Z=c0+c1*P+c2*P^2 (|Z|<1), primitive B=c1*P^2/2+2*c2*P^3/3; fixed Z or fixed P also makes the sector integrable.
realizability: For K>0 and |Z|<1, D=K*Z/sqrt(1-Z^2), pLgprime=(pSg*Sgprime+pg*tgprime-D)/Lg; algebraic jet condition only.
counterexample: Unrestricted (pLg,pLgprime) slice has nonzero curvature; rational non-Step55 witness -32/375.
